args.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our form wrongly treated it as a fridge problem; we've corrected it and logged it as a front door repair. Until it's fixed, please avoid slamming the door (the glass could break) and keep clear of the glass if it does. Two quick questions: does the front door lock and stay secured when shut, so the flat is safe now? And is the glass cracked or damaged at all? Also, are there any access details or pets we should know about for a visit? We're asking the landlord to approve the repair and will update you by 2024-06-07.
